changeSet.sql: create table LOGIN ( ID NUMBER(38) DEFAULT login_seq.nextval NOT NULL, ACCOUNT_ID NUMBER(38) NOT NULL, NAME VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL, NOTES VARCHAR2(1000), TIMESTAMP_CREATION TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL, TIMESTAMP_UPDATED TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL, SITE VARCHAR2(100), USERNAME VARCHAR2(100), PASSWORD VARCHAR2(100) )
